name: ERA Content Selector for LLMs.txt
author: badea

sections.description:
ERA Content Selector for LLMs.txt creates a public /llms.txt file for AI crawlers and assistants. It can include all published pages, posts, WooCommerce products, and public custom post types, or only the exact items selected by the site admin.

The plugin includes:

  • Blue styled WordPress admin screen.
  • Content type toggles for pages, posts, products, and custom post types.
  • Specific item picker for selected pages, selected products, and selected posts.
  • Manual text editor for the generated llms.txt file.
  • Automatic regeneration after content updates.
  • Virtual /llms.txt fallback when the WordPress root is not writable.
  • Basic support for SEO descriptions from Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and SEOPress meta fields.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the era-content-selector-for-llms-txt folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings > Content Selector for LLMs.txt.
  4. Choose content types, select specific items if needed, then generate the file.
sections.faq:
Where is the file available?

The file is available at /llms.txt on the public site.

Can I edit the file manually?

Yes. Use the Manual File Editor in Settings > Content Selector for LLMs.txt.

Does it support WooCommerce products?

Yes. If WooCommerce is active, public products are available as a content type and can be selected individually.
